note: Set A repeatedly binds plain dimensions to the detail title itself (e.g. 'Duct Framing Detail | width | 1'-4"', 'clearance/gap | 1"', 'component | W10X12'), invents units ('2" in', '1" in'), duplicates the plate and scale claims, calls a detail bubble a 'component B', and states the scale as only '1 1/2"' instead of 1 1/2" = 1'-0". Set B keeps the drawing's detail/typical conditions, correctly reads section shapes (C3X6 channel, L4X4X5/16 angle, PL5X3/8 plate, HSS 4X4X1/4, W10X15) and ties them to the details where they appear. B is not clean either: it calls 10" the depth of a C3X6 member, invents 'bottom'/'right side' duct-opening clearances and a weld size, and repeats the 11 1/2" spacing claim while assigning 11 1/2" and 6" to Duct Framing Detail 3 although those dimensions sit in the A5 detail block. Overall B's claims are better bound and conditioned, so it wins despite those errors.
